From the Owner

30 Years in the Field.
Now Building Something of Our Own.

After 30 years in the well logging industry, I’m proud to announce the launch of Statewide Well Surveys LLC.

I’ve been fortunate to spend my career doing work I genuinely enjoy, and starting Statewide gives me the opportunity to continue doing that work while building something of our own.

Statewide is a family-owned and family-focused business built around experience, quality data, dependable service, and fair, straightforward pricing. Being a smaller, family-owned company allows us to stay personally involved, keep costs reasonable, and focus on what matters most — quality work, dependable service, and real value for our clients.

We’re combining decades of hands-on field experience with modern logging technology while keeping the personal service and accountability that have always been important to me.

Most of all, I’m excited to build something with my family that we can be proud of, grow together, and continue for years to come. I’m looking forward to reconnecting with people I’ve worked with over the years, meeting new clients, and getting Statewide Well Surveys out in the field.

Joe Abreau
Owner — Statewide Well Surveys LLC
What We Stand For

The SWS Difference

We built Statewide around the values that have always mattered most in this business — and the ones that too often get lost as companies grow.

01

Field Experience

30+ years of hands-on well logging across municipal, agricultural, environmental, engineering, and mining projects throughout the Western U.S.

02

Personal Involvement

As a family-owned company, we stay personally involved on every project. You deal with the owner, not a dispatcher. That accountability matters to us.

03

Fair Pricing

Smaller and family-owned means lower overhead and fair, straightforward pricing. No markups to cover layers of management you’ll never talk to.

04

Modern Technology

Dual-platform SDS Warrior and Robertson Geologging systems. The latest digital tools combined with the experience to use them correctly.
